support_caveats: Only platforms named in included_platforms are supplied by this package.
The Linux binary requires glibc 2.28 or newer.
Eligible Windows x86-64 Stata/MP 19 GUI numeric input is parallel; loading Break may be delayed or unavailable.
Native Intel-host Stata testing is outstanding; the macOS plugin contains both processor slices.
The accepted Linux no-FE 16-regressor, one-worker slowdown of 7.3% versus beta.14 remains; see docs/VALIDATION.md.

The accepted saved-effect refinement is 5.7% faster than 0.5.2 on the easy cell, 1.5% slower than its historical arm and 2.1% slower on the difficult cell, measured on one physical Linux host; see docs/VALIDATION.md.
performance_acceptance: Historical Mac weak-auto-t4 and weak-cmg-t4 cells remain INCONCLUSIVE with the owner acceptance dated 2026-11-06. The historical 0.5.2 saved-effects gate remains FAIL (paired ratio 1.1020), accepted on 2026-11-07. The fixed 63-call refinement comparison passes every current gate; Johannes accepted its remaining 1.5% historical easy-case gap and 2.1% difficult-case cost and authorized main integration. All measurements and failures remain preserved; no adverse results were resampled.
